name: SheetJS Community Edition
notes: The two runtime modules are unmodified bytes from the official vendor archive; no third-party fork is used.
The adjacent d.mts files are project-authored integration declarations, not vendor runtime code.
The rules parser imports these local modules and does not use the legacy npm xlsx dependency.
Pinned byte integrity and runtime version are checked by tests/local-document-parser.test.ts.
Input/output limits do not replace process CPU and memory limits for arbitrary document parsing.
